svg.title: Membrane concept: gold nanoparticle monolayer on a silica nanosphere support
svg.desc: Schematic cross-section of the proposed design, not to scale. A single layer of ligand-coated gold nanoparticles drapes over smaller silica spheres and spans the gaps between them; the small spheres sit on a base of larger silica spheres, about 1 micrometre across. Water passes through the pores of the gold monolayer and the open spaces between the silica spheres; particles larger than the monolayer pores stay on top. An inset shows the monolayer from above, with a small pore at the centre of each triangle of particles.
svg.text: particles larger than the pores stay on top
